notes:
Original Study 1a is available and title/DOI verified against the supplied reference. No specific outcome/test locator was supplied; the overall standardized physical-warmth-extraction composite is extracted as the broad-description match. Individual frequency, duration, and temperature correlations are different tests and were not merged. Recruited sample (51) is not assumed to equal test-specific analytic n. Replication identifier ferrell_2013 is not a resolvable DOI. Reference searches identified the primary PsychFileDrawer report URL https://www.psychfiledrawer.org/replication.php?attempt=MTg3; direct acquisition failed with DNS resolution error, and a Wayback alternative was inaccessible. No primary full text or author narrative verdict was obtained; secondary descriptions were not used to fill replication statistics or success.
Source follow-up: Rendered target PDF page inspected; canonical TXT quoted verbatim. Report is undated; data Fall 2013, expected citation 2014. Selected the explicitly hypothesis-relevant temperature correlation; the separate composite Physical Warmth Index is r = -.03, p = .535, n = 365 on the same page, and PDF p.6 Table 1 prints higher precision correlations. Report body PDF1–5 is distinguished from author supplemental tables PDF6–9. No supplied replication item locator; outcome selection is explicit.
